notes.title: Patch 1.2 now available
notes.content:
Fixed a few bugs in the game
- The pause menu was not showing when pressing ESC
- Added roll in the game to dodge enemy attacks
- Created a few UI's to help guide the players better
- Fixed the door when inserting a key 
- Enemy hit slower 

- If you have more questions or other bugs, please contact KevMinGaming@gmail.com
